Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency profile you showed. We're ready to move forward on a GCP marketplace listing but want to align on the co-sell play and sequencing. High-level asks from our side:
- Target listing date: early Sep (internal deadline)
- Joint GTM: 6-week activation plan post-listing
- Need confirmation on GCP co-sell eligibility checklist + any partner manager support during listing review

I've attached a draft mutual action spreadsheet (Aurelius_MA-Plan_v1.xlsx) with our suggested milestones. Can your PM and partner manager review and propose ownership?

Best,

Head of Cloud Partnerships
Aurelius Health

Rafi — thanks for the clear asks and the MA plan. Looping in Vanessa (Partner Manager) and Karthik (PM, marketplace) to map ownership. Quick responses to your bullets:
- Target listing date (early Sep): feasible if we lock listing assets by 8/2 and solve a short technical dependency (service account + billing export).
- Joint GTM 6-week activation: agreeable; we'll propose the 6-week play with milestones for enablement, pilot customers, and co-marketing assets.
- Co-sell eligibility checklist: I'll attach our internal checklist (gcp-listing-checklist.pdf) and Vanessa will confirm required intake fields and who is the GCP POC.

Next step: Vanessa, can you review the MA spreadsheet and highlight rows you want Redwood to own? Karthik — can you flag any listing blockers on the technical side by EOD Friday?

Thanks — Soojin

Thanks Soojin — reviewed the MA plan and I've annotated ownership and suggested dates directly in Aurelius_MA-Plan_v1.xlsx. High-level notes for Aurelius:
- Redwood will own: listing submission, co-sell registration, one joint success story (pilot), and initial co-marketing creative.
- Aurelius to own: GCP billing export confirmation, compliance questionnaire returns, and pilot customer introductions.
- Joint: enablement session, pricing alignment, and Go/No-Go 2 weeks before listing date.

I've proposed a weekly 30-min pipeline reconciliation call (Tuesdays 11:00 PT) starting 8/3 to keep everyone aligned. Also adding a short action ledger for priority items:
1) Karthik: confirm whether we need a dedicated service account + sample billing export schema (due 7/23).
2) Aurelius: provide compliance questionnaire (SOC2 summary) and a primary technical contact (due 7/26).
3) Soojin/Vanessa: submit co-sell registration (target 7/30).

Rafi — is the 8/3 kickoff and Tuesday cadence okay? If yes, I'll send a calendar invite and link to the mutual action plan in Drive.

—Vanessa
Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Aurelius_MA-Plan_v1.xlsx (annotated, 52 KB)

Quick technical update and risks (per action 1):
- Service account: we do NOT need a dedicated service account for listing itself, but we need a billing export sample and a test dataset so we can validate the ingestion pipeline. If Aurelius can provide a sanitized export (schema + 2 sample rows) that will unblock our staging tests.
- Timing: If we get the test export by 7/26 and marketing assets by 8/2, we can meet the early-September listing window. Any slip in the export pushes listing by ~2–3 weeks.
- Compliance: SOC2 summary is sufficient for the initial review — full attestation can come later but will be required before co-sell registration closes.

Action items captured here for the ledger:
- Aurelius: provide export schema + sample rows (due 7/26)
- Aurelius: provide SOC2 summary and primary tech contact (due 7/26)
- Redwood (Vanessa): send listing assets checklist and Drive link (done 7/22)
- Redwood (Karthik): run staging ingest and confirm success (target 7/30)

I'll post test results in the Drive folder and update HubSpot (HO-34219) with milestone status. See you on 8/3 for the weekly reconciliation.

—Karthik
Product Manager, Marketplace, Redwood Inference
